comments.body: This started after the pagination change landed last week.

content.text: This started after the pagination change landed last week.
Steps to reproduce: open customer cannot log in with a workspace that has more than one member.
Expected: the view keeps the selected filters after a reload.
Actual: filters reset to the default and the row count changes.
Impact: reported by two customers this week; no data loss observed.
